summary: HEY-04: poa.operation/v1 shared operation contract for registries

delivery.outcome: POA publishes poa.operation/v1: one closed record (operation_id, URI, JSON Schema arguments, POA effect classes, risk, lifecycle, provenance with source digest) that action, procedure, process and generated-operation registries use to import and export each other's entries. A dependency-free validator adds the rules JSON Schema cannot express (secret scanning, destructive implies high risk, generated implies generator and code digest), and conformance --all runs 2 positive examples and 25 adversarial rejections.
nonGoals: No change to poa.process/v1 or ticket-queue schemas.
The document grants no authority and admits no execution.
Registry adapters live in heyasa and autonom (HEY-04 follow-ups, AUT-004).

architecture.decision: A separate closed schema next to poa-process reusing its identifier/effect/sha256 vocabulary; the validator reuses poa_primitives and is wired into conformance.py like ticket_queue.
architecture.rollback: Revert the commit; no consumer depends on it until the adapters land.
